title: Spell stat calculator
problem: Carries damage-only "ignore Defense" blocks that weaken Defense-based stat spells (Living Cloak etc.).
notes: Fix: S: skip those blocks 2026-10-26: built as byte patch SU-0027 (verified against the baseline exe; not yet run in game). | 2026-10-26 crash fix: the jump over L60-L104 also skipped the first set of the temp RValue [rbp+0x50]; the first line after L104 releases that temp before reuse, so stack garbage could be freed (user crash at battle start on an Animator save, fault in the spell-id switch of bc_SpellStat; bisected in game to this patch). The jump now goes through a cave stub that sets the temp to undefined (flags 0, kind 5), as the skipped block did. Audit of every jump-over patch for locals first set inside a skipped range: no other real case (SU-0043 / SU-0108 flags are saved-register or written-first slots). | 2026-10-26 crash fix, corrected cause (the temp alone did not fix it: same crash on retest): the skipped block is also where the compiler first sets r15 = 0 (its zero register; the L310 spell-id switch starts its index from r15d, so garbage indexed past the case table) and the cached constants xmm9 = 100.0, xmm12 = 0.25, xmm15 = 0.1, xmm13 = 0.3. The stub now sets those too. tools/skip_audit.py checks registers as well as stack slots (it flags the previous stub).

release_notes.intended: Spells that grant stats based on the caster's Defense use its full Defense.
release_notes.actual: In the unpatched game, effects meant to ignore a target's Defense for damage also lowered the Defense these stat spells were based on.
release_notes.fix: Now 'ignore Defense' effects only affect damage, so these stat spells use the caster's full Defense.
